correctness.rationale: The equation with one central input makes the horizontal component of R(z) zero by nondegeneracy. With R(z)=cz, the defining identity is equivalent to (A-cI)^T J(A-cI)=c(c-lambda)J and imposes no condition on the central functional. This is reversible, including in characteristic two. At a zero multiplier, count ordered isotropic frames, divide by bases per image, and count surjections to the image. At a nonzero multiplier a symplectic-basis block dilation provides a representative and the multiplier fiber is a coset of Sp; counting symplectic bases gives the claimed order. The scalar polynomial has one or two distinct roots according as the weight is zero or not. These are shifted ranks, not ranks of R. Fresh enumeration of horizontal blocks in dimension five over F_2 against the unshifted identity checked, per singular c, ranks 0,1,2 with counts 1,225,3150 and the nonsingular block count 720, before the 16 choices of functional; totals are 65536 and 108032. Replay: python /tmp/opencode/frozen_review_reproduce.py heisenberg.
residual_risks: The exhaustive numerical check fixes the center-preserving block form, whose necessity is proved separately; it does not verify all q computationally.
